description.value: Nanaimo Art Gallery is an ambitious public contemporary art gallery founded in 1976 and now situated in the heart of downtown Nanaimo on Commercial Street, on the traditional territory of the Snuneymuxw First Nations. The gallery presents rotating exhibitions of contemporary art alongside robust programs for all ages, and operates on an admission-by-donation model that makes it genuinely accessible to all visitors. A touring cyclist exploring downtown Nanaimo will find it a short walk from the waterfront, neighboured by cafes and shops along a lively commercial strip.
